function: Complex-valued GNN detector recovers OTFS delay-Doppler symbols under fractional Doppler and imperfect channel gain and Doppler estimates, as a learned message-passing detector (p. 2, p. 5-6).
system: OTFS link, antenna count not stated (scalar path gains), 8x8 grid, 15 kHz spacing, 4 GHz, 500 km/h, 3 paths, 4/16-QAM, no RIS (p. 7, Table II).
method: Complex-valued GNN: unfolded message passing with residual blocks, complex GRU and fully connected layers; supervised training with split MSE loss on labeled symbols; Adam, up to 200 epochs (p. 5-7).
data_channel: Self-generated OTFS dataset: P=3 paths with fractional Doppler, 500 km/h, channel gain and Doppler estimation errors, SNR 0-30 dB; custom simulator, not 3GPP or measured (p. 2, p. 6-7).
test_conditions: Training dataset mixes diverse numbers of paths, estimation errors, and noise (p. 6); testing on 50,000+ independent pairs over SNR 0-30 dB, P=3,4,5, and gain/Doppler error variances (p. 7-9).
baselines: Non-learned: ML, MMSE, OAMP; learned: GNN (real-valued), GNN with residual (GNN-v2), AMP-GNN [24] (p. 7-8).
metrics: BER vs SNR, number of paths, iterations, and gain/Doppler estimation error; parameter count (M) and runtime (ms) (p. 8-9).
complexity: Big-O per detector (Table I, p. 7); parameter count 1.31 M and runtime 6.81 ms versus GNN 31.19 ms and AMP-GNN 21.21 ms (Table IV, p. 9).
q1_support: p. 7: "The total number of paths is set as P = 3" with maximum delay and Doppler indices of 3 and 2 (Table II); the generic delay-Doppler channel of Eq. (4), p. 2, is a custom simulator, not 3GPP, COST 2100, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 6: "our training dataset incorporates received signals with diverse numbers of paths, channel estimation errors, and noise"; p. 7: "independent data pairs with different SNR ranging from 0 to 30 dB". Tests are held-out samples and sweeps of the training distribution; no unseen scenario is stated.
q3_support: p. 8: "the proposed CV-GNN outperforms the AMP-GNN detector by 1 dB and outperforms the GNN detector by 2 dB"; Fig. 5 on the same page also plots the non-learned OAMP, MMSE, and ML detectors on BER.
q4_support: p. 6: "computational complexity of CV-GNN detector is" followed by a Big-O expression (Table I, p. 7); Table IV, p. 9, gives parameters (1.31 M) and runtime (6.81 ms).
q5_support: p. 2: "we construct a dataset encompassing both channel gain and Doppler estimation errors"; the dataset is self-generated and no code or data link appears anywhere in the paper.
notes: Title page 1 matches the DOI. Area 4 rather than 1 because the detector works on the OTFS delay-Doppler channel, the more specific area. The paper never states the antenna configuration; the channel is a scalar multipath model (Eq. 4, p. 2), so the link is treated as single-antenna, which is allowed for OTFS. The paper mentions generalization ability (p. 7) but tests on independent samples of the same distribution, so q2 is not met. The GNN baseline is the real-valued counterpart described in Section III-B (p. 4-5), so only AMP-GNN [24], an earlier published OTFS detector, is the learned baseline that counts for q3.
